text: This report recommends that the name "Campbell Russell Lane" be approved to identify a public lane in block bounded by College Street, Augusta Avenue, Oxford Street and Bellevue Avenue. Community Councils have delegated authority to decide street naming matters which comply with the City of Toronto Street Naming Policy.
The Toronto and East York Community Council: 1. Approved the name "Campbell Russell Lane" for a public lane in a block bounded by College Street, Augusta Avenue, Oxford Street and Bellevue Avenue.
